title: 1906 San Francisco earthquake
summary: A magnitude 7.9 earthquake struck off the northern California coast on April 18, 1906, when the San Andreas Fault slipped along about 270 miles (430 km). A four-day fire followed and destroyed some 28,000 buildings. The death toll is now believed to exceed 3,000, and about 250,000 people were left homeless. The city was rebuilt to be earthquake- and fire-resistant.
